div.div: ضُؤُلَةٌ , (S, O, TA,) like تُوَدَةٌ, (O, TA,) in the copies of the K ضُؤْلَة, but the former is the right, (TA,) an epithet applied to a man, (S, O,) Lean, or spare: (S:) or weak, (K, TA,) lean, or spare, and despicable, abject, or ignominious. (TA.) [See also ضَئِيلٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
